description:
Can you find the hidden Sprouts?-

Because Astro gives every Toon dreams to help them sleep at night, he takes their nightmares in return. The reason he's always tired is because he doesn’t want to go to sleep and live through those nightmares himself. 

Because of Astro and Dandy's relationship, Dandy almost always wants Astro with him in his dreams. So Astro gets to live through the kind of dreams he would want for himself vicariously through Dandy. But things can get extremely unhealthy for the both of them if they aren't careful as it gives them a world to hide away in from everyone else when things are getting stressful. They both have a habit of runnning away from their problems and towards each other for comfort, instead of fixing what needs fixing.

LYRICS:

Tonight, let me take your fears as you sleep again
Rest inside this dream I made for you,
so every nightmare finds my heart instead of yours
Wake,
Wake with joy while I endure it all alone

Beloved, 
relax in this pool of stars to bring your heart ease and rest
Rest,
don't worry about me, your peace has always been my purpose
So I'll see you in the morning knowing I gave you my best
Just promise you'll speak with me when the new day comes
lest the ichor filled your lungs

Tonight, don't drown in blackened ink,
I'm here for you
Take my hands and coat me too
if your dream is for us to sink together then,
All you had to do was ask and we will drown with each other
In a pool of black petals and black stars
